::: {#def-inverse-relation}
#### Inverse relation (converse relation)

Let $R$ be a relation from a set $A$ to a set $B$ (@def-binary-relation).
The **inverse** of $R$ [@wikipedia_converse_relation]
(also called the **converse** of $R$)
is the relation from $B$ to $A$ that reverses each pair of $R$:

$$
R^{-1} \eqdef \set{(b, a) : (a, b) \in R}.
$$

:::
